hints: Make one pass over the events. Keep the index of each turn span and each model span as you create them, so a child can name its parent.
A turn span starts at its first event and moves its end on every event of that turn, except run_end. The run span moves its end on every event, run_end included.
Nearly the code: the run is out[0]; a tool_call creates a tool span under turn_index[turn]; a model_reply sets the end and the output tokens of the model span of its turn.
solution:
"""Turn a trace into spans. The span structure (run, turn, model call, tool call) is the course's own;
the names and attribute keys follow the OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions (C12.o3).

events: the trace's events in order. Each is a dict with "kind", "t" and, where the kind has one, "turn".
Return a list of spans in the order each one first appears in events. A span is a dict with
"name", "kind", "parent" (the index in the list of the parent span, None for the run), "start", "end" (t values)
and "attributes" (a dict).

- The run span comes first. It is kind "run", named "invoke_agent <agent>" from run_start, and it ends at the t
  of the last event (run_end included).
- A turn span, kind "turn", named "turn <n>", is a child of the run. It starts at the first event whose turn is n
  and ends at the last such event; run_end is not part of a turn.
- A model span, kind "model", named "chat <model_id>" from run_start, is a child of its turn. It starts at
  model_call and ends at the model_reply of the same turn. Its attributes are gen_ai.request.model (model_id),
  gen_ai.usage.input_tokens (tokens_in of model_call) and gen_ai.usage.output_tokens (usage.output_tokens of the reply).
- A tool span, kind "tool", named "execute_tool <tool>", is a child of its turn. It starts and ends at tool_call.
  Its attributes are gen_ai.tool.name (tool) and gen_ai.tool.call.id (tool_use_id).

An empty trace gives an empty list.
"""


def spans(events):
    out = []
    model_id = ""
    turn_index = {}
    model_index = {}
    for event in events:
        kind = event.get("kind")
        t = event.get("t")
        if kind == "run_start":
            model_id = event.get("model_id", "")
            out.append({"name": f"invoke_agent {event.get('agent')}", "kind": "run", "parent": None,
                        "start": t, "end": t, "attributes": {}})
            continue
        if not out:
            continue
        out[0]["end"] = t
        if kind == "run_end":
            continue
        n = event.get("turn")
        if n not in turn_index:
            turn_index[n] = len(out)
            out.append({"name": f"turn {n}", "kind": "turn", "parent": 0, "start": t, "end": t, "attributes": {}})
        turn = out[turn_index[n]]
        turn["end"] = t
        if kind == "model_call":
            model_index[n] = len(out)
            out.append({"name": f"chat {model_id}", "kind": "model", "parent": turn_index[n], "start": t, "end": t,
                        "attributes": {"gen_ai.request.model": model_id,
                                       "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens": event.get("tokens_in")}})
        elif kind == "model_reply" and n in model_index:
            span = out[model_index[n]]
            span["end"] = t
            span["attributes"]["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"] = event.get("usage", {}).get("output_tokens")
        elif kind == "tool_call":
            out.append({"name": f"execute_tool {event.get('tool')}", "kind": "tool", "parent": turn_index[n],
                        "start": t, "end": t,
                        "attributes": {"gen_ai.tool.name": event.get("tool"),
                                       "gen_ai.tool.call.id": event.get("tool_use_id")}})
    return out

tests:
from kata import spans

TRACE = [
    {"kind": "run_start", "seq": 0, "t": 0, "turn": 0, "agent": "main", "model_id": "claude-sonnet-5-5"},
    {"kind": "prompt_built", "seq": 1, "t": 0, "turn": 1, "tokens": 329},
    {"kind": "model_call", "seq": 3, "t": 0, "turn": 1, "tokens_in": 329},
    {"kind": "model_reply", "seq": 5, "t": 1400, "turn": 1, "usage": {"input_tokens": 329, "output_tokens": 39}},
    {"kind": "tool_call", "seq": 7, "t": 1500, "turn": 1, "tool": "read_file", "tool_use_id": "toolu_1_1"},
    {"kind": "prompt_built", "seq": 10, "t": 1500, "turn": 2, "tokens": 2381},
    {"kind": "model_call", "seq": 12, "t": 1500, "turn": 2, "tokens_in": 2381},
    {"kind": "model_reply", "seq": 14, "t": 2600, "turn": 2, "usage": {"input_tokens": 2381, "output_tokens": 60}},
    {"kind": "tool_call", "seq": 16, "t": 2700, "turn": 2, "tool": "write_file", "tool_use_id": "toolu_2_1"},
    {"kind": "run_end", "seq": 18, "t": 2800, "turn": 2, "status": "done"},
]


def test_the_run_is_the_first_span():
    assert spans(TRACE)[0] == {"name": "invoke_agent main", "kind": "run", "parent": None, "start": 0, "end": 2800, "attributes": {}}, "the run starts at run_start and ends at the last event"


def test_each_turn_is_a_child_of_the_run():
    found = spans(TRACE)
    assert (found[1]["name"], found[1]["kind"], found[1]["parent"]) == ("turn 1", "turn", 0), "turn 1 is a child of the run"
    assert (found[4]["name"], found[4]["parent"]) == ("turn 2", 0), "turn 2 is a child of the run too"


def test_a_model_call_is_named_for_its_model():
    found = spans(TRACE)
    assert (found[2]["name"], found[2]["kind"], found[2]["parent"]) == ("chat claude-sonnet-5-5", "model", 1), "the model span is named for the model and sits under its turn"


def test_the_model_span_carries_the_token_counts():
    assert spans(TRACE)[2]["attributes"] == {"gen_ai.request.model": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "gen_ai.usage.input_tokens": 329, "gen_ai.usage.output_tokens": 39}, "input from model_call, output from the reply"


def test_a_tool_call_is_a_child_of_its_turn():
    found = spans(TRACE)
    assert found[3] == {"name": "execute_tool read_file", "kind": "tool", "parent": 1, "start": 1500, "end": 1500, "attributes": {"gen_ai.tool.name": "read_file", "gen_ai.tool.call.id": "toolu_1_1"}}, "the tool span sits under turn 1"
    assert (found[6]["name"], found[6]["parent"]) == ("execute_tool write_file", 4), "the second tool sits under turn 2"


def test_a_turn_ends_at_its_last_event():
    found = spans(TRACE)
    assert (found[1]["start"], found[1]["end"]) == (0, 1500), "turn 1 ends at its tool call"
    assert (found[4]["start"], found[4]["end"]) == (1500, 2700), "turn 2 ends at its tool call, not at run_end"


def test_a_run_without_run_end_ends_at_its_last_event():
    assert spans(TRACE[:-1])[0]["end"] == 2700, "with no run_end, the run ends at the last event"


def test_an_empty_trace_gives_no_spans():
    assert spans([]) == [], "no events, no spans"
